g.text: Each round: apply the top remarks of `vibepiler compile . -R`, re-run with --baseline. Round 1 deleted waste; rounds 2–3 split the most tangled functions; round 4 folded duplicates and accepted the judgment calls.

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: Tangle is the share-weighted noisy OR of per-function terms; bloat = 1 − (1 − waste)(1 − tangle). Measured at -O3, 54% of call sites linked.

path.style: fill: #0b6b4a; stroke: #0b6b4a; stroke-width: 1.0; stroke-linecap: butt; stroke-linejoin: miter
